FEAT-5-S155.title: Pydantic Tool Input Schema Enforcement
FEAT-5-S155.description: Implement strict validation of tool inputs using Pydantic models mapped per allowlisted tool, ensuring all incoming tool_use payloads conform to expected schemas before execution.

FEAT-5-S156.title: Core Allowlist Dispatch Execution
FEAT-5-S156.description: Implement the core dispatch mechanism that matches tool_use requests to allowlisted handlers, executes the corresponding domain service via facades, and returns structured results to the agent loop.

FEAT-5-S157.title: Tool Router Integration with FastAPI Endpoint
FEAT-5-S157.description: Integrate the tool_router into the FastAPI request lifecycle, ensuring tool_use blocks from the LLM are intercepted, routed through the allowlist system, and responses are reinjected into the conversational loop.

FEAT-5-S158.title: Tool Router Unit and Integration Test Coverage
FEAT-5-S158.description: Expand automated tests to cover allowlist enforcement, schema validation failures, successful dispatch paths, and adversarial inputs using existing test_tool_router.py and integration scenarios.
